name: com.xxhq.htmltougui
description:
Convert HTML + CSS content into Unity UGUI (Canvas) hierarchies at Editor time. Supports CSS selectors, pseudo-classes, variables, em/rem/%/calc() units, three layout calculators, a pluggable tag-handler system, and SpriteAtlas conversion utilities.

将 HTML + CSS 内容转换为 Unity UGUI 层级结构。支持 CSS 选择器、伪类、变量、em/rem/%/calc() 单位、三种布局计算器、可插拔标签处理器系统和 SpriteAtlas 转换工具。

samples.description: Example scene demonstrating HTML to UGUI conversion with a pre-configured index_optimized.html file, sprite atlas, and UGUI canvas output.
